purpose: Binary meta-labeling gate (take/skip) on top of ic32 LGBM primary — evaluated vs hard_consensus cascade before production deploy

primary.task: multiclass LGBM — direction from argmax directional proba

candidate_mode.description: Lower threshold for OOF label generation — meta learns which marginal signals to skip
candidate_mode.rule: max(p_long, p_short) >= candidate_thr AND winner beats loser

production_mode.description: Production entry thresholds (for reference only, not used for meta training)

meta.label: win = 1 if net_pnl > 0 after fees+slippage, else 0
meta.label_source: walk-forward OOF — LGBM retrained per fold, predict only on val fold (no leakage)

exit_sim_for_labeling.tp: none — simplified for fast OOF generation
exit_sim_for_labeling.note: Holdout ablation uses full_trading_report (swing TP/SL + Guardian) — label sim is intentionally simpler

anti_patterns: Do NOT use in-sample trade simulation for meta labels (meta_labeling_v1 leak)
Do NOT stack meta + LSTM + all entry filters without ablation
Do NOT deploy on AUC alone — PnL/PF on holdout is the gate
Do NOT replace Guardian with meta — entry and exit stay separate
